models.label: ECMWF IFS 0.25°
models.note: ECMWF's operational physics model, open-data release. Its gust field is a maximum over the output interval, not an instantaneous value, so gust factors look large in light air.

models.label: ECMWF AIFS
models.note: ECMWF's machine-learning model - a genuinely independent opinion. Publishes no gust field, so gusts come from IFS and ICON-2i only.

models.label: ItaliaMeteo ICON-2i
models.note: ItaliaMeteo / ARPAE high-resolution model for Italy - the finest grid available here. Runs only ~60-72 h ahead and updates every 12 h, so it drops out of the longer-range view.

models.label: Météo-France MFWAM
models.note: Full sea-state decomposition - total wave, wind wave and swell with heights, directions and periods.

models.label: ECMWF WAM 0.25°
models.note: Total significant wave height only - used to cross-check MFWAM.

briefing.headline: Very light, settled pattern over the Aeolians now - useful context only; the trip dates are still beyond any reliable call.
briefing.synopsis: The islands are sitting in a slack, near-windless regime: consensus winds across all models at Portorosa, Lipari, Panarea, Stromboli, Filicudi and Salina run 1-6 kt through 01 Oct, with a daily rhythm of light NE-E in the morning swinging N to NNW by evening, and gusts touching 13-17 kt in the afternoon sea-breeze hours (Salina 17.7 kt at 18:00 on 01 Oct is the highest in the set). Seas are essentially flat - wave and swell 0.1-0.4 ft everywhere in the current-conditions data. No pressure system, front or Mistral/Scirocco event appears in the payload out to the model horizon of 05 Oct 23:00. If this pattern held, it would be a motoring trip with occasional light-air sailing on the afternoon breeze.
briefing.overnight_anchorage: The fleet is not aboard yet; the first scored berth is Portorosa on the night of 03 Oct, where the recommendation is Portorosa Marina - an enclosed marina with all-round shelter, scored 1.0, with 4 kt SE, gusts 8.7 kt and 0.1 ft swell in the current guidance. Nothing in that berth forecast would push the fleet to move. Treat it as indicative only at this lead time.
briefing.tomorrow_morning: Nothing changes materially in the next 24-48 h in this data: light NE-E overnight and early, filling to a few knots from N-NNW in the afternoon, seas 0.1 ft. There is one flagged model disagreement at Portorosa for 01 Oct 00Z and 06Z, where the spread is 1.0-7.9 kt - the mean around 5 kt should not be treated as certain. No departure window applies yet; the boarding-day briefing on 03 Oct will be the first one that matters.

passage_notes.note: Currently scored go all day, best at 06:00: 6 kt SE, gusts 11.5 kt, 0.1 ft sea, a run. Wind backs to NNE and close-hauled by midday. Lead time is 5 days - expect this to change.
Go on current guidance but 3-4 kt NNE on the nose all day, 0.1 ft sea - a motoring leg as it stands. At the very edge of the model horizon.

Also scored go, 3-4 kt N-NNE, 0.1 ft sea, head to wind early. Note Marina del Gabbiano is rated only workable - open from every direction and no anchoring - so shelter there depends entirely on it staying calm.

passage_notes.leg: Panarea → Filicudi, Filicudi → Salina and later legs
passage_notes.note: Beyond the forecast horizon of 05 Oct 23:00. No forecast exists for these dates; the rehearsal runs in the payload are a dry run on this week's weather, not a forecast for the trip.

cautions: Everything above is pre-trip context. The trip dates themselves are largely outside the data - only the first two legs are covered at all, and at 4-6 days lead.
Portorosa 01 Oct 00Z/06Z shows a model spread of 1.0-7.9 kt - genuine disagreement, not a firm number.

Afternoon gusts in the current data reach 13-17 kt against 3-6 kt means; the IFS gust field is an interval maximum, so the factor looks large in light air, but expect some sea-breeze bite mid-afternoon.
Marina del Gabbiano, Stromboli: exposed 0-359° and no anchoring - only viable while it stays calm.
All go/caution verdicts in the payload are conservative computed thresholds, not decisions. The skipper decides.
briefing.confidence_note: At 4-6 days out the payload's own stability tracking shows mean direction shifts of 64° and wind shifts up to 4.4 kt at 72-120 h lead, ICON-2i does not reach the trip dates at all, and most legs sit past the 05 Oct model horizon.

verification.measures: forecast stability, not verified accuracy - the reference is the newest model run for the same hour, not an observation
